description: This file defines a question generator agent for a medical exam prep bot, utilizing a state graph workflow to generate and validate questions, with batch processing capabilities.

classes.name: QuestionState
classes.description: TypedDict schema representing the state of the question generation workflow

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent class that manages question generation workflow, including validation and batch processing

methods.name: _build_graph
methods.description: Constructs the state graph workflow for question generation

methods.name: _should_regenerate
methods.description: Determines whether to regenerate a question based on validation results and attempt count

methods.name: generate_single_question
methods.description: Generates a single validated question for a specified chapter and difficulty

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Generates multiple questions concurrently in batches
